title: RaceTrack
description: A race's simplified GPS track: data/running/published/race-tracks/<run-id>.json. The ONLY published schema allowed to contain coordinates. Exists only for races that are not treadmill runs and whose map is not hidden.

points.description: [lat, lon, dist_m, elev_m] after trimming the ends and simplifying. elev_m is null where not recorded.
points.tsType: Array<[lat: number, lon: number, dist_m: number, elev_m: number | null]>

trim_ends_m.description: Metres removed from each end of the track (owner race.yaml trim_ends_m).

bbox.tsType: [min_lat: number, min_lon: number, max_lat: number, max_lon: number]
